notes.author: claude-fable-triage
notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Benilla defines SMSG_INITIAL_SPELLS (book + cooldown list), SMSG_LEARNED_SPELL, SMSG_SUPERCEDED_SPELL, and the five server-side cooldown packets. MSUI implements the book trio field-exactly (PlayerActions.ApplyInitialSpells incl. the cooldown list and the permanent-cooldown spell_cd_ms==1 skip, Learn/Supercede) plus SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN with correct self/pet addressing and the cooldown_ms==0 use-Spell.dbc fork, but the other four cooldown packets have no handler.
